annotations.title: Buy the domain for a live build (code prowess)

description: Operator token only, during a "code prowess" build the owner authorized with a spending cap. Buys ONE domain for the business through our registrar (owner-paid; no customer charge), points it at the server and starts HTTPS. Use dry_run first to compare endings. Exact business name within the cap beats a cheaper near-miss. Auto-renew stays off. Then publish_site and poll publish_status. A refused or unchecked domain ending carries `reason` and a plain `reason_text`: unsupported or price_unavailable mean we do not sell that ending right now; lookup_failed or cap_reached mean it was NOT checked, so search again, and never tell the customer we do not sell it.

domain.description: The ONE domain to buy for this business, bare, e.g. "heapy.net". Pick the exact business name on any ending that fits the grant's remaining cap before a cheaper misspelling (heapy.net at $90 beats heeepy.com at $40). Check prices first with dry_run.

dry_run.description: true = quote only: registrar, cost for the minimum term, and whether it fits the cap. Buys nothing.

site_key.description: The site this domain is for (optional; for your own bookkeeping).
